reason: This passage (Exodus 1:15-22) does not mention priests at all. It depicts the Pharaoh of Egypt, Hebrew midwives (meyyaledot), and the Hebrew people. The only religious figures referenced are the midwives themselves, who are shown fearing God (yareʾu et-ha-ʾElohim) and are blessed by God (vayeitiv ʾElohim lamet yalledot). No priests (kohanim) or priestly figures appear in this text.
